hypothesis: A positive five-minute BTC price shock accompanied by expanding open interest, positive terminal taker flow, and positive terminal top-ten book imbalance may occur often enough to justify a separately preregistered continuation-outcome experiment.
decision: Reject the exact count-only candidate as cadence-insufficient. Do not query its forward outcomes, retune its thresholds, add it to V58, or represent it as a viable BTC long route. The loosest full candidate produced only 6 development onsets versus the frozen minimum of 20, then 2 validation and 4 pseudo-holdout onsets versus 10 required in each. Preserve V58 unchanged and require materially new causal information or an untouched prospective window before reopening BTC-long research.
falsifier: A source-identity, receipt-time causality, gap-reset, completed-bar, threshold, onset-deduplication, or count-reproduction defect that materially changes the registered onset counts invalidates this rejection. Economic edge remains unmeasured and cannot falsify a cadence-only result because the preregistration prohibited outcome queries.
